patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: I've got this boring pain in the pit of my stomach that goes straight through to my back, and I keep throwing up. It's a bit better if I lean forward. I do drink most nights.
clinical.presentationShort: 50yo M — epigastric pain radiating to the back, relieved leaning forward, vomiting, alcohol use — acute pancreatitis.
clinical.presentationLong: 50-year-old male with epigastric pain boring through to the back, partially relieved by leaning forward, with vomiting and a history of alcohol use — acute pancreatitis.

diagnosis.disposition: Acute → lipase, labs, IV fluids, analgesia, antiemetics; assess severity; monitor.
diagnosis.why: Epigastric pain to the back + vomiting + alcohol/gallstones = pancreatitis. Lipase confirms; fluids are the mainstay.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: hunched forward, both hands over his upper abdomen
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 50-year-old man, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: hunched forward, both hands over his upper abdomen. Expression: in pain and a little sweaty. Clearly visible: a forward-hunched posture with hands over the upper belly. No text, no logos.
